definitions.gloss: acceleration; rate of change of velocity
definitions.explanation: A physics term for the rate at which the speed of an object changes over time. Also used figuratively to describe the increasing pace of change.

examples.japanese: {加速度|かそくど}を{計算|けいさん}する。
{重力|じゅうりょく}{加速度|かそくど}は{約|やく}9.8m/s²だ。
{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}は{加速度|かそくど}を{増|ま}して{進|すす}んでおり、{社会|しゃかい}の{変化|へんか}がますます{速|はや}くなっている。
examples.english: Technological innovation is accelerating, and social change is getting faster and faster.

notes:
Composed of {加速|かそく} (acceleration, speeding up) + {度|ど} (degree, rate). Primarily a physics term, but also used in figurative contexts to describe processes that are speeding up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重力|じゅうりょく}{加速度|かそくど}: gravitational acceleration
- {加速度|かそくど}センサー: accelerometer
- {加速度|かそくど}を{増|ま}す: to increase in acceleration
- {加速度|かそくど}がつく: to gain momentum
- {加速度|かそくど}{的|てき}に: at an accelerating rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加速|かそく}: acceleration, speeding up — the act of accelerating, without the quantitative nuance
- {速度|そくど}: speed, velocity — the rate of movement itself, not its change
- {減速|げんそく}: deceleration — the opposite, slowing down
